Question 11
?

If A={0,4,8,…,80}, which collection of subsets of A is a partition of A?

a
{{0,8,12},{16,20,…,80}}
b
{{0,8,16…,40},{48,56,…,80}}
c
{{0,4,8,…,36},{40,44,48,…,76},{80}}
d
{{0,2,4,…,40},{44,46,…,80}}
